description: Adds the preset rules that let Sergio read a booking platform's or form relay's notices, as the rule editor's Add rules for a platform does: platform is one the picker lists. Only the rules this business does not already have are inserted, so a repeat adds nothing. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first result.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: add_platform_email_preset
title: Add a platform's email rules
